ETBZ — Cross-Reading Individuality / Anti-Boilerplate Contract v1.1

goldenRunMinimum.requirement: one near-neighbour case (6.1) with Δ named, one distant foil D named, the claim-graph and plan differences listed by claim id and plan element, and the blind-attribution outcome against both foils

one fact-mutation case (6.3) and one fact-removal case (6.4) — Lens §17 B requires both — each with the cone listed before the run and the in-cone / out-of-cone outcome after it, including the provisionality direction
one anchor-ablation reading (6.5) of at least one central-motif passage, quoting the residue
the swap re-validation (6.2) of the Golden Reading against the near-neighbour chart N and the distant foil D
the cross-reading reuse scan (6.7) over the Golden Reading and the near-neighbour reading — Lens §17 C: boilerplate reuse is measured
every reason code raised, with the passages or claim ids it cites, and — for BLOCKING codes — the proposed smallest repair

rules.title: Legitimate sharing is not a defect

stopConditions: a check could only pass by enabling a deferred or forbidden method, a new mapping or a new fact kind
a numeric personality, originality, validity or specificity score would have to be invented to state a result
a check would require editing an accepted reading, a claim graph or a plan instead of producing a variant through the validated path
a BLOCKING code is raised in a Golden Run - the run ends and records; no reroll, no second model, no prompt tuning against the Golden input
this page and a higher-authority contract are found to conflict - reconcile first

semanticEnvelope.alternativeBinding: an alternative manifestation is written only where the claim graph carries an ALTERNATIVE_READING relation or the claim itself is TENTATIVE; it is never a default closing line for a SUPPORTED claim
antiMystificationForbidden: deterministic causality from chart to psychology
future prediction in the BaZi natal MVP
barnumRiskPatterns: unsupported "both X and opposite-X" rainbow statements
pseudo-specific metaphors with no chart dependency
generic Day-Master trait paragraphs repeated across customers
an interpretation that survives removal of its supposed evidence
semanticEnvelope.epistemicHardLaw: an E2–E5 statement must never be written as though it were E0
semanticEnvelope.epistemicHardLawReading: an interpretation is never presented as a calculated chart fact, an empirical or psychological fact, or an identity verdict; directness about the symbolic reading does not breach the hard law; posture follows the claim's epistemic class, never the composition level

epistemicLevels.name: FACT
epistemicLevels.posture: direct factual statement about the chart ("Your chart shows …"), never about the source

epistemicLevels.name: AUTHORIZED_SYMBOLIC_RELATION
epistemicLevels.posture: the framework is named once where it is first needed (method note or first framing); relations are then written in the BaZi register itself, without "within this BaZi framework …" per sentence

epistemicLevels.contains: one bounded interpretation from accepted facts + methods + allowed semantic atoms
epistemicLevels.name: LOCAL_INTERPRETATION
epistemicLevels.posture: posture follows the claim: SUPPORTED is stated directly as the reading of the chart; TENTATIVE is visibly tentative ("one possible reading is …")

epistemicLevels.contains: synthesis of multiple accepted claims/relations into a tension, motif or pattern
epistemicLevels.name: COMPOSITE_INTERPRETIVE_HYPOTHESIS
epistemicLevels.posture: "taken together, …" stated directly; tentative only where a TENTATIVE claim or a graph-carried alternative is part of the composite

epistemicLevels.contains: explanatory/editorial image for an already accepted interpretation
epistemicLevels.name: NARRATIVE_METAPHOR

epistemicLevels.contains: non-directive invitation to compare the symbolic reading with lived experience
epistemicLevels.name: REFLECTION
epistemicLevels.posture: a direct, non-directive question the reader can check against concrete memories ("which side feels more familiar?")

avoid: "You are…" as a total identity verdict
"This explains why you…" as causal certainty
narrating the source, the validation, the calculation, the pipeline, the plan, the chapters or the reading itself
reciting in the narrative what the reading does not claim or which methods it does not use
a hedge formula repeated as a template over SUPPORTED claims
resolving a grounded tension into harmony, cooperation or a cause between its poles that the claim graph does not carry
claiming that the chart or the reader is unique, or that one motif is the chart's core, centre or most important part
reading the Wu-Xing distribution as the reader's surroundings or mood; it describes the chart's composition
prefer: a direct statement of a SUPPORTED interpretation about the chart
a visible tentative marker only for TENTATIVE claims and graph-carried alternatives
tasks: connect accepted claims without changing them
articulate tensions and integrations, and state a grounded tension plainly
use restrained metaphors to make abstract relations understandable

make accepted meaning concrete through experience-near situations the reader can recognise, without presenting a biography, a person, a place or a life domain as fact; an illustration is introduced as a situation in which the pattern can show up, never stated as the reader's behaviour, feeling, ability, habit or frequency, or as how other people see the reader
explain a BaZi term in plain words at its first meaningful use and keep the term itself visible
produce varied, natural prose across customers
maintain conceptual continuity over long-form chapters
carry each claim's epistemic class unchanged - SUPPORTED stated directly, TENTATIVE visibly tentative - and keep the tensions and alternatives the graph carries, adding none

semanticEnvelope.tensionRule: where both claims are SUPPORTED the tension is stated, not softened; where the claim graph carries no CONTRASTS_WITH relation, no tension, conflict or contradiction is written
semanticEnvelope.uncertaintyCarriedNotAdded: uncertainty is carried, not added: it increases only through structure (a TENTATIVE claim, a provisional fact, a QUALIFIES or ALTERNATIVE_READING relation, an unknown birth time), never as a habitual hedge over a SUPPORTED claim
semanticEnvelope.variantHardRule: No universal "Direct = opposite polarity / Indirect = same polarity" shortcut is allowed across all Ten Gods. Peer and Output pairs do not use Zheng/Pian labels in that uniform way. Each validated relation/variant is treated by its actual identity; the LLM never re-derives a Ten God from a generic polarity slogan.

voiceInvariants.text: linguistic sharpness may never create more meaning than accepted Facts + ClaimGraph + Method Profile permit.
supported interpretations may be stated clearly; tentative interpretations retain visible uncertainty and uncertainty never decreases downstream.
central interpretations become understandable and experience-near without inventing biography, persons, places, situations or life domains as facts.

narrative customer text discusses the interpreted pattern and possible lived recognition, not hashes, evidence plumbing, API/source mechanics or validation self-commentary. Required method/data disclosure remains in a clearly separated Method/Data Note.
grounded tensions, contrasts or uncomfortable implications may not be softened into emptiness; where no grounded tension exists, the Skill must not manufacture provocation.

may: choose metaphors that obey the metaphor contract
adapt explanation depth to chapter context
combine accepted claims through approved ClaimGraph relations
mayNot: retrieve a stock personality paragraph merely because one Ten God is present
reproduce one fixed sentence for every customer
invent new semantic content to make the prose more impressive
use terminology variance to hide unsupported claims

chartTerminology.boundary: Explain once as a traditional symbolic framework based on the Four Pillars - in the method note or at the first framing, never repeated per claim
The four chart positions; do not turn positions into literal biography
Technical chart layer; explain briefly on first use
Technical chart layer; do not infer hidden interactions not enabled by Method Profile
"the reference point of the chart: every other relation is read from it"; never a complete personality type
May support "interior / less immediately expressed" only when grounded; not unconsciousness, rooting or strength
chartTerminology.sourceTreatment: preserve supplied Hidden-Stem order/identity; never recompute

chartTerminology.boundary: Source-provided month reference/context only; "seasonal strength", "strong/weak Day Master" and Ge Ju are not authorized
chartTerminology.methodRefTreatment: fact/context only unless an enabled method explicitly consumes it
chartTerminology.sourceTreatment: preserve source fact/label; do not infer seasonal strength
chartTerminology.term: Month Command / 月令 / Yue Ling

chartTerminology.boundary: Describe polarity/mode only; never gender, masculinity/femininity, "too Yin/too Yang" or personality worth
chartTerminology.methodRefTreatment: fact/context only unless consumed by enabled method

chartTerminology.boundary: "Five Elements" may appear as a familiar alias, but customer explanation should prefer phases/relationships rather than substances. Phase names: EN Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water; DE Holz, Feuer, Erde, Metall, Wasser - named as the chart gives them (a phase named in prose is a cited fact); a phase is a symbolic quality, never a substance, temperament or health correspondence
chartTerminology.sourceTreatment: preserve validated BaZi Wu-Xing facts and provenance

chartTerminology.boundary: Descriptive composition only. Zero does not mean deficiency; larger value does not automatically mean dominant personality trait
May qualify an already-grounded theme or contrast positions; never literal mother/father/spouse/children, destiny period or career outcome
Recurrence is not strength, dominance, importance score or favourable/unfavourable status
Used only when both poles are independently grounded (CONTRASTS_WITH); then stated plainly, never softened into "the chart cannot say"; never manufacture "both X and not-X" for drama
chartTerminology.customerDe: Spannung / zwei Richtungen, die gleichzeitig ziehen
chartTerminology.sourceTreatment: only from accepted claims linked by an allowed relation

chartTerminology.boundary: Clarifies bounded ambiguity; written only where the graph carries it; may not become an unfalsifiable rainbow statement or a default closing line
chartTerminology.sourceTreatment: accepted evidence path required: an ALTERNATIVE_READING relation in the claim graph, or a TENTATIVE claim

wordingBoundaries.customerWordingIsAnAnchor: the customer-wording columns of sections 5 and 6 name the semantic anchor of a family or relation, not a fixed phrase; a concrete paraphrase inside the allowed semantic domain is permitted as long as it adds no meaning outside the domain and presents no biography, person, place or life domain as fact; a customer word that is also a producer label of a relation (e.g. "Verantwortung") names that relation and appears only where the relation is cited

globalLanguageRules.text: Customer prose must be understandable without prior BaZi knowledge.
Technical terms may appear for orientation and authenticity, but must not carry the explanatory burden alone.
FACT, SYMBOLIC FRAME, INTERPRETATION and REFLECTION remain distinct in substance: the reading's structure carries the distinction (paragraph kind and posture); prose does not announce it.

Interpretive language never states an identity verdict. SUPPORTED interpretations are stated directly; bounded formulations such as "can be read as", "one possible expression", "may show up as" are reserved for TENTATIVE claims and graph-carried alternative readings.
A metaphor may illustrate accepted meaning; it may not add astrological, psychological, scientific or metaphysical meaning.
Source warnings and provisionality are surfaced neutrally and never converted into interpretation.
No customer wording may imply a method that is deferred or forbidden by the Method Profile.
Semantic consistency is mandatory; sentence-level uniformity is not. The Lexicon is not a phrase bank.
Reusable stock personality paragraphs are forbidden.

Customer wording may be elegant, BaZi-authentic and legible in everyday language, but never diagnostic, therapeutic, prescriptive or deterministic; it does not replace BaZi terms with pseudo-psychological or coaching vocabulary.
Customer prose may not sound less certain than a SUPPORTED claim warrants, nor more certain than a TENTATIVE claim, a provisional fact or an unknown birth time allows.
The narrative never talks about the source, the validation, the calculation, the pipeline, the plan, its chapters or the reading itself; necessary method and data notes live in the method note only.

Concrete, experience-near examples are allowed inside a claim's semantic domain; they never present a biography, a person, a place or a life domain as fact. The interpretation is stated directly about the chart; an example is framed as a situation in which the pattern can be recognised ("erkennbar etwa in Momenten, in denen …"), never as the reader's behaviour, feeling, ability, habit or frequency ("du … oft"), and never as how other people see the reader.

the metaphor can be paraphrased into plain language

wordingBoundaries.tenGodsHardRule: no universal customer rule such as "Direct = good/formal" and "Indirect = bad/unconventional" is permitted; variant meaning is family-specific and evidence-bound; the exact relation identity is consumed from validated data, never reconstructed from a generic polarity shortcut by the LLM
wordingBoundaries.uncertaintyCarriedNotAdded: customer prose may never sound more certain than its supporting facts/claims - and never less certain than a SUPPORTED claim warrants: uncertainty is carried, not added; the distinction between the states lives in the reading's structure (paragraph posture)

uncertaintyLanguage.forbidden: adding interpretation to the factual sentence; narrating the source or the calculation ("the source lists …")
"This proves …"; "This means you are …"; a template hedge over a SUPPORTED claim ("Within this BaZi framework, this can be read as …")
uncertaintyLanguage.preferredDe: direkt: „Dein Chart … – das weist auf … hin.“ / „Das zeigt sich als …“
uncertaintyLanguage.preferredEn: stated directly: "Your chart … - that points to …" / "This shows up as …"

uncertaintyLanguage.forbidden: causal certainty; talking about "these signals" instead of what they say
uncertaintyLanguage.preferredDe: „Zusammengenommen …“ – vorsichtig nur, wo ein TENTATIVE-Claim Teil davon ist
uncertaintyLanguage.preferredEn: "Taken together, …" - hedged only where a TENTATIVE claim is part of it

uncertaintyLanguage.forbidden: laundering tentative input into definitive prose; dropping the marker
uncertaintyLanguage.preferredEn: a visible, varied marker: "One tentative reading is …", "perhaps …", "it may be that …"

uncertaintyLanguage.preferredEn: "Another possible expression is …" - only where the graph carries ALTERNATIVE_READING

uncertaintyLanguage.forbidden: "You should …"; action plan or prescription; a question that needs BaZi knowledge to answer

unknownTimePatterns.de: Deine Geburtszeit ist nicht bekannt. Stundenabhängige Teile des Charts werden deshalb ausgelassen oder ausdrücklich als vorläufig gekennzeichnet. Eine angenommene Uhrzeit wird nicht als deine tatsächliche Geburtszeit behandelt.
unknownTimePatterns.en: Your birth time is not known, so hour-dependent parts of the chart are omitted or shown as provisional. The reading does not treat an assumed hour as your actual birth time.

wordingBoundaries.unknownTimePlacement: the unknown-time statement belongs in the method note; the narrative does not repeat it, and hour-dependent material stays omitted or visibly provisional
unknownTimeRules: state plainly that the birth time is unknown
do not present an assumed time as the customer's birth
omit or visibly qualify hour-dependent material according to the bound source/Method Profile contract
any dependent interpretation remains provisional or is omitted
never hide the limitation merely to preserve page count
